scriptDescriptions.typecheck: Type-checks every package with `tsc --noEmit` under the repository's strict compiler settings.
scriptDescriptions.test: Runs the whole vitest suite once.
scriptDescriptions.lint: Runs ESLint with the functional-subset configuration.
scriptDescriptions.check: The gate: typecheck, lint, ratchet, tests, backlog ids, INDEX.md completeness, and doc-block freshness, stopping at the first failure.
scriptDescriptions.dashboard: Starts the agent observability server on http://localhost:4747.
scriptDescriptions.backlog:regen: Rebuilds the generated backlog/BACKLOG.md and backlog/DONE.md views from item frontmatter.
scriptDescriptions.backlog:archive: Moves done and dropped backlog items into backlog/archive/.
scriptDescriptions.backlog:next-id: Claims the next free BL-NNNN id for a slug and creates its empty item file.
scriptDescriptions.backlog:validate: Reports duplicate, misnamed, or unclaimed backlog ids.
scriptDescriptions.codeview: Starts the code overview browser on http://localhost:4848.
scriptDescriptions.stats: Reports size distributions of this repository's functions, statements, and expressions.
scriptDescriptions.clones: Reports expressions that repeat under different names; `-- --extract N` plans the extracted function.
scriptDescriptions.transcripts: Analyzes a project's Claude Code session transcripts and reports where the tokens went.
scriptDescriptions.init: Plans and applies this repository's strictness gates in another repository.
scriptDescriptions.mcp: Starts the MCP server over the code index on stdio.
scriptDescriptions.hooks:install: Points this clone's git hooks at .githooks so the pre-commit staging guard runs.
scriptDescriptions.docs:regen: Rewrites the generated inventory blocks in README.md and docs/tools-and-process.md; `-- --check` reports staleness instead.
